text.p: Steel pipe-maker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) has detailed three previously announced global share offerings for 1997 and 1998, the Mexican Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
The first phase will be an offer of 70 million shares through a convertible instrument in the United States and Europe during the first half of 1997.

The offer "implies maintaining these shares until the end of the term to exercise the corresponding conversion ... which will not exceed five years from the ... issuing of the instrument", the stock exchange said in a news release.
In the second phase, Ahmsa will place a mixed global issue of up to 55 million shares before the end of 1997.
The third offering, due by the end of 1998, will involve up to 100 million shares in Mexico and abroad and could involve a secondary offer.
Ahmsa has said cash raised from the share offerings would be used to pay off debts.
